content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I am encountering an issue with a [product_name] device at my workplace. When one of the inputs is activated by applying 110V, the Run/Stop LED begins to blink red and green, indicating an error. I suspected that the inputs might be defective, so I reassigned the software to use two other unused inputs. However, the problem continued with these new inputs as well. The program had not been modified for several years until I switched the inputs. Does anyone have an idea of what might be causing this? I would appreciate any assistance. Thank you.
Hello, Could you specify which [product_name] model is being used? Please provide the [article_no] for further assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user reports that a [product_name] module in an industrial setting enters an error state—with blinking red and green LEDs—whenever certain inputs are activated. Reassigning the program to use different inputs did not resolve the issue, suggesting possible hardware failure or persistent input error. The issue is recent, after years of stable operation, and it is causing interruptions to normal processes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects dependable input functionality from the [product_name] module, along with clear diagnostics to identify the root cause swiftly. They are seeking expert guidance to pinpoint and rectify the problem so the occurrence does not repeat with other inputs.
